name: complex
description: Demo database for complex types in Trino: ARRAY, ROW and MAP nested to any depth, and JSON. The table is in the memory catalog, since the connector of the other Northwind tables, MariaDB, has no nested types.

columns.name: tags
columns.label: Tags
columns.description: List of text values; elements are addressed 1-based

columns.name: scores
columns.label: Scores
columns.description: List of integers; numeric elements for lambda arithmetic

columns.name: vec
columns.label: Vector
columns.description: Array of three doubles; Trino has no fixed-size array

columns.name: matrix
columns.label: Matrix
columns.description: Array of two arrays of three doubles: the first index selects the row

columns.name: dims
columns.label: Dimensions
columns.description: Flat row (struct) of width and height

columns.name: address
columns.label: Address
columns.description: Row holding a nested row (geo) and an array (phones)
columns.dialectType: ROW(street VARCHAR, geo ROW(lat DOUBLE, lon DOUBLE), phones ARRAY(VARCHAR))

columns.name: attrs
columns.label: Attributes
columns.description: Map from text keys to text values

columns.name: counts
columns.label: Counts
columns.description: Map from text keys to integer values

columns.name: lookup
columns.label: Lookup
columns.description: Map with integer keys: a numeric selector is a key here, a position in a list

columns.name: items
columns.label: Items
columns.description: List of order-line-like structs: sku, quantity, price and a list of options
columns.dialectType: ARRAY(ROW(sku VARCHAR, qty INTEGER, price DECIMAL(10,2), opts ARRAY(VARCHAR)))

columns.name: events
columns.label: Events
columns.description: List of structs with temporal fields

columns.name: deep
columns.label: Deep
columns.description: Four levels: a list of maps whose values are structs holding a list and a map of lists
columns.dialectType: ARRAY(MAP(VARCHAR, ROW(a ARRAY(INTEGER), b MAP(INTEGER, ARRAY(VARCHAR)))))

columns.name: doc
columns.label: Document
columns.description: JSON document; JSON paths count from 0, selectors count from 1

columns.name: odd
columns.label: Odd
columns.description: Row with a mixed-case field name that needs quoting
